integrity: Proof and independently implemented symbolic/numeric checker are provided; full-text comparisons are literature-bounded. No independent audit or experimental validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The statements classify linear local stability of an explicitly positive equilibrium under a balanced zero-diagonal stage-interaction matrix and common demographic transfer. Boundary eigenvalues with zero real part do not determine nonlinear stability, and random-network, global-survival and empirical interpretations are not established. Classical matrix identities and related ecological stability methods are prior art.
title: A sharp circulation-controlled stability frontier in balanced two-stage ecological networks
